newsitem.title: USA: Rollins sees near term hurt by expansion.
newsitem.headline: Rollins sees near term hurt by expansion.

text.p: Rollins Inc said Monday it would be hurt in the near term by the expansion of its service delivery network.

Gary Rollins, president and chief operating officer, said in a statement, "We continue to execute our strategic plans to expand our service delivery network while redirecting our revenue mix. Although in the near term we will be negatively effected by this initiative, the long-term benefits to the company will be significant."

Rollins owns and operates Orkin Exterminating Co Inc, which offers termite and pest control services, and also provides lawn acre and plantscaping services; and Rollins Protective Services, in electronic security systems.

Earlier, the company reported that third quarter revenues increased 0.1 percent to $162,514,000. Net income decreased 4.3% to $3,306,000 from $3,454,000. Earnings per share were $0.09, equal with last year. For the nine months ended Sept 30, revenues increased 0.5 percent to $482,863,000 with net income decreasing30.4 percent to $22,534,000 for an earnings per share of $0.63 compared to $0.90 for the same period last year.

For the quarter, Orkin's revenues increased 0.5 percent while operating income decreased 63.7 percent. Orkin had an increase in customers and recurring pest control and termite renewal revenues. However, these gains were offset by a decrease in termite sales revenue. The operating income for the quarter was negatively effected by branch and region openings, operating insurance costs, and termite claims.
